settings.support.blurb.original: If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting its development:
settings.support.blurb.translation: Bu plagin sizga foydali boʻlsa, uning rivojlanishini qoʻllab-quvvatlashni oʻylab koʻring:

settings.support.mission.original: …and help seed a bigger vision: technology that serves people and planet..
settings.support.mission.translation: …va kattaroq orzuni ekishga yordam bering: insonga va sayyoraga xizmat qiladigan texnologiya.

settings.support.license.viewTooltip.translation: Litsenziya va masʼuliyatdan voz kechishni koʻrish

settings.support.license.acceptLabel.translation: Litsenziya va masʼuliyatdan voz kechishni qabul qilish

settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.original: Path to the templater plugin template file to use
settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.translation: Foydalaniladigan Templater plagini shablon faylining yoʻli

settings.transcripts.info.original: Transcript settings control how and where your extracted notes are saved, which youtube data API key to use (required for channel/playlist processing), and optional language-translation parameters.
settings.transcripts.info.translation: Transkript sozlamalari yozuvlaringiz qanday va qayerda saqlanishini, qaysi YouTube data API kaliti ishlatilishini (kanal va pleylistlar uchun zarur) hamda ixtiyoriy tarjima parametrlarini belgilaydi.

settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.original: The root folder where transcript subfolders will be organized (e.g., inbox, notes, etc.)
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.translation: Transkript ichki jildlari tartibga solinadigan asosiy jild (masalan inbox, notes va hokazo)

settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.original: Your Google cloud console API key for accessing public YouTube transcripts (not an OAUTH token). Required for downloading channels and playlists.
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.translation: Ommaviy YouTube transkriptlariga kirish uchun Google cloud console API kalitingiz (OAUTH tokeni emas). Kanal va pleylistlarni yuklab olish uchun zarur.

settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.original: Optional key for scrapecreators transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method. Get a free key at app.scrapecreators.com (100 requests free). Recommended for reliable transcript retrieval; direct YouTube extraction breaks when YouTube changes how captions are served.
settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.translation: scrapecreators transkript xizmati uchun ixtiyoriy kalit. Belgilansa, asosiy usul sifatida ishlatiladi. app.scrapecreators.com saytidan bepul kalit oling (100 ta soʻrov bepul). Ishonchli transkript uchun tavsiya etiladi; YouTube subtitrlarni berish usulini oʻzgartirganda toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri olish ishdan chiqadi.

settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.original: Optional key for supadata transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method (if no scrapecreators key). Get a key at supadata.ai.
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.translation: supadata transkript xizmati uchun ixtiyoriy kalit. Belgilansa, asosiy usul sifatida ishlatiladi (scrapecreators kaliti boʻlmasa). Kalitni supadata.ai saytidan oling.

settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.original: Target language code for translation (e.g., en, es, fr, de). Use "en" to keep content in english.
settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.translation: Tarjimaning maqsadli til kodi (masalan en, es, fr, de). Matnni ingliz tilida qoldirish uchun “en” dan foydalaning.

settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.original: Target country/region code for translation (e.g., us, gb, ca). Used for region-specific language variants.
settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.translation: Tarjimaning maqsadli mamlakat/mintaqa kodi (masalan us, gb, ca). Mintaqaviy til variantlari uchun ishlatiladi.

settings.llm.info.original: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key, and pick a model. Temperature controls creativity; max tokens caps output length. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; Google's gemini-2.5-flash is cheaper, but its lower-cost tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.info.translation: AI provayderini tanlang, uning API kalitini kiriting va model tanlang. Temperatura ijodkorlikni boshqaradi; maksimal tokenlar javob uzunligini cheklaydi. Ishonchlilik uchun OpenRouter tavsiya etiladi; Google gemini-2.5-flash modeli arzonroq, ammo uning arzon darajalari sekinlashtirilishi mumkin.

settings.llm.provider.desc.original: Provider used for summarization. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; lower-cost Gemini tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.provider.desc.translation: Xulosa uchun ishlatiladigan provayder. Ishonchlilik uchun OpenRouter tavsiya etiladi; arzon Gemini darajalari sekinlashtirilishi mumkin.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.original: Stored in Obsidian secret storage, not in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.translation: Plagin maʼlumotlarida emas, Obsidian maxfiy xotirasida saqlanadi.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.original: Server URL, stored in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.translation: Server URL manzili, plagin maʼlumotlarida saqlanadi.

settings.llm.model.desc.original: Select a preset model or type a custom model name below.
settings.llm.model.desc.translation: Tayyor modelni tanlang yoki quyida oʻz model nomingizni yozing.

settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.original: Required: this model isn't in the registry — set context window, max output, and reserve % so token budgeting can size requests safely.
settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.translation: Zarur: bu model roʻyxatda yoʻq — token hisobi xavfsiz boʻlishi uchun kontekst oynasi, eng koʻp chiqish va zaxira foizini belgilang.

settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.original: These are this model's token limits, prefilled from known data. Edit a field to override it for this provider and model.
settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.translation: Bular shu modelning maʼlum maʼlumotlardan toʻldirilgan token chegaralari. Shu provayder va model uchun oʻzgartirish kiritish maydonni tahrirlang.

settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.original: Total context window in thousands of tokens (e.g., 400 for 400k tokens)
settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.translation: Ming token hisobida toʻliq kontekst oynasi (masalan 400k token uchun 400)

settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.original: Maximum output tokens in thousands (e.g., 128 for 128k tokens)
settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.translation: Mingda eng koʻp chiqish tokenlari (masalan 128k token uchun 128)

settings.llm.inputMax.desc.original: Explicit input cap if vendor publishes one (leave empty to auto calculate)
settings.llm.inputMax.desc.translation: Provayder eʼlon qilgan boʻlsa, aniq kirish chegarasi (avtomatik hisob uchun boʻsh qoldiring)

settings.llm.reservePct.desc.original: Safety reserve for output tokens (0.10 = 10%, default: {default})
settings.llm.reservePct.desc.translation: Chiqish tokenlari uchun xavfsizlik zaxirasi (0.10 = 10%, standart: {default})

settings.llm.temperature.desc.original: Controls randomness of output (0-1). Lower is more focused, higher is more creative. Current value: {value}
settings.llm.temperature.desc.translation: Chiqishning tasodifiyligini boshqaradi (0-1). Past qiymat aniqroq, yuqori qiymat ijodkorroq. Joriy qiymat: {value}

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.original: Automatically add date to the beginning of note filenames
settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.translation: Yozuv fayl nomlari boshiga sanani avtomatik qoʻshish

settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.original: Format for date prepended to note titles
settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.translation: Yozuv sarlavhalari oldiga qoʻyiladigan sana formati

settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating fast summaries
settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.translation: Tez xulosa yaratishda llms xatti-harakati uchun koʻrsatmalar

settings.prompts.userFast.desc.original: Specific instructions for summarizing the transcript quickly and concisely
settings.prompts.userFast.desc.translation: Transkriptni tez va qisqa xulosalash uchun aniq koʻrsatmalar

settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.original: Please summarize the following YouTube transcript...

settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating detailed, comprehensive summaries
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.translation: Batafsil va keng qamrovli xulosalar yaratishda llms xatti-harakati uchun koʻrsatmalar

settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.original: Specific instructions for creating detailed and structured notes from the transcript
settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.translation: Transkriptdan batafsil va tuzilgan yozuvlar yaratish uchun aniq koʻrsatmalar

settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.original: From the transcript below, create detailed and structured notes...
settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.translation: Quyidagi transkriptdan batafsil va tuzilgan yozuvlar yarating...

settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.original: Choose the default summary mode to use when the plugin starts. Fast summary mode skips timestamp links for quicker processing.
settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.translation: Plagin ishga tushganda ishlatiladigan standart xulosa rejimini tanlang. Tez xulosa rejimi tezroq ishlash uchun vaqt belgisi havolalarini oʻtkazib yuboradi.

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.original: Add links to each numbered section heading that jump to the corresponding timestamp in the YouTube video (note: disabled in fast summary mode)
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.translation: Har bir raqamlangan boʻlim sarlavhasiga YouTube videosidagi tegishli vaqt belgisiga oʻtadigan havola qoʻshing (eslatma: tez xulosa rejimida oʻchirilgan)

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.original: When enabled, reduces first pass tokens by 12% to make room for links. Automatically disabled in fast summary mode.
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.translation: Yoqilganda havolalarga joy ochish uchun birinchi bosqich tokenlarini 12% ga kamaytiradi. Tez xulosa rejimida avtomatik oʻchadi.

settings.advanced.info.original: Advanced settings for debugging and troubleshooting. Enable debug logging to get detailed information appended to each note for technical support.
settings.advanced.info.translation: Nosozliklarni tuzatish uchun qoʻshimcha sozlamalar. Texnik yordam uchun har bir yozuvga batafsil maʼlumot qoʻshilishi uchun nosozlik jurnalini yoqing.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.original: Enable detailed debug logs. When enabled, debug information will be appended to each note as a hidden callout for troubleshooting.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.translation: Batafsil nosozlik jurnallarini yoqing. Yoqilganda nosozlik maʼlumotlari har bir yozuvga yashirin blok sifatida qoʻshiladi.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.original: When enabled, debug information will be collected and added to notes as a hidden callout instead of being logged to the console.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.translation: Yoqilganda nosozlik maʼlumotlari konsolga yozilish oʻrniga toʻplanadi va yozuvlarga yashirin blok sifatida qoʻshiladi.

license.modal.loadError.original: Could not load license file. Please check that a license file exists in your plugin directory.
license.modal.loadError.translation: Litsenziya faylini yuklab boʻlmadi. Plagin jildingizda litsenziya fayli borligini tekshiring.

license.required.message.original: You must accept the plugin license before using this feature.
license.required.message.translation: Bu imkoniyatdan foydalanishdan oldin plagin litsenziyasini qabul qilishingiz kerak.

license.required.instruction.original: Please go to the plugin settings and accept the license terms to continue.
license.required.instruction.translation: Davom etish uchun plagin sozlamalariga oʻtib, litsenziya shartlarini qabul qiling.

license.required.step2.original: Scroll down to the "Community Plugins" section in the sidebar
license.required.step2.translation: Yon panelda jamoa plaginlari boʻlimiga pastga suring

license.required.step3.original: Find "Tubesage" in the Community Plugins list

license.required.step5.original: Toggle "Accept license & disclaimer" to enable the plugin
license.required.step5.translation: Plaginni yoqish uchun “Litsenziya va masʼuliyatdan voz kechishni qabul qilish” tugmasini yoqing
